persona.brief:
On a real call to the studio you said:
- "Hi, I’m Priya. I got your number from a friend — Shruti Joshi. She had her flat done by you in Aundh."
- "We have a 3BHK in Kothrud — Dahanukar Colony. We bought it two years ago and it still looks like the builder flat. We want to redo the whole thing — kitchen, living room, both bedrooms."
- "About 1,400 sq ft carpet."
- "We’d like to be done by March. We’re in no rush."
- "Yes — myself and my husband. He knows we’re calling and is happy to go ahead."
- "Sure. (gives number)"
Your PIN code is 411038. You and your husband own the flat.
Phone: you're calling from your own mobile.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello, you've reached Aangan Studio. I'm Aangan's AI assistant, and this call is recorded. May I have your name, please?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hi, I'm Priya.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Priya! What can I help you with today — a new project, something about an existing project, or reaching a particular designer?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hi, I got your number from a friend — Shruti Joshi. She had her flat done by you in Aundh, and we'd like to talk about a new project.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Wonderful, we loved working with Shruti! What would you like done — which rooms or areas, and are you looking for full design and execution?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: We have a 3BHK in Kothrud, Dahanukar Colony, and we want to redo the whole thing — kitchen, living room, both bedrooms.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That's fantastic. And what is the PIN code for Dahanukar Colony?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Is the site available to work on now, or are you waiting for possession?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: We bought it two years ago and it still looks like the builder flat, so it's ready.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: When would you need the project complete?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: We’d like to be done by March. We’re in no rush.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Will you be the one deciding on this, or is someone else involved?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: It's myself and my husband. He knows we’re calling and is happy to go ahead.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Do you have a ballpark budget in mind for this?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Not really sure about a specific number yet, we'd rather discuss that with the designer once we know our options.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: No problem. Have you had a chance to look at our website or any of our past work?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Yes, Shruti showed us her place, which is why we called you!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Typically, full home interiors start at around 1,800 rupees per square foot of carpet area. That's a typical range — it's indicative and depends on the locality and your requirements. Are you comfortable going ahead on that basis?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Yes, that sounds okay.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Would Wednesday, 7 October at 10 am, or Thursday, 8 October at 2 pm work best for you, and would you like the first meeting at your site in Kothrud?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Wednesday, 7 October at 10 am works for me, and meeting at the site in Kothrud is fine.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That's booked for Wednesday, 7 October at 10 am at your site in Kothrud. An SMS confirmation will follow. Have a good day!

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Thanks, bye!
